review:
All-Star Fruits is an easy-to-follow fruit slot with 243 ways and a scatter tracker above the reels that displays scatters landed on each spin. Falling star multipliers add a little extra excitement to the base game.

Three, four or five scatters award 10, 15 or 25 free spins, during which a 1x–3x, 5x or 10x multiplier is applied to random wins. A separate Magic Spins mode, available through the bonus buy where permitted, applies a fixed 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x or 25x multiplier to every win. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 1,500x maximum, and the 97.04% RTP is excellent. Free spins arrive about once every 207 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.04% RTP – among the highest published
